payload.title: Reject orders when there isn't enough stock. Before placing an order, check availability with the inventory team's Stock API: GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku} returns { "sku": string, "available": number }. If any line asks for more than is available, POST /orders must return 409.

payload.content:
Implemented stock validation for `POST /orders`.

- Added `StockGateway` and production `HttpStockGateway` calling `GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku}`.
- Added injectable `stockGateway` to `createApp`.
- Checks every order line before payment, save, or event publication.
- Returns `409` with `insufficient_stock` when requested quantity exceeds availability.
- Inventory API failures return `502`.
- Added adapter and order-flow tests.
